headline: Dengue claims 6 lives in 24 hours, 1,948 hospitalized
summary: Bangladesh records another grim day in the dengue outbreak, with 6 deaths and nearly 2,000 new hospital admissions in the last 24 hours. The total death toll this year has now reached 245.
details: The Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room reported 6 deaths due to dengue in the last 24 hours. During the same period, 1,948 people were admitted to various hospitals across the country with dengue.
The latest figures indicate a continued surge in dengue cases. The cumulative number of dengue deaths this year has now reached 245, with a total of 79,620 hospital admissions recorded.

Hospital admissions were spread across various divisions, with the highest numbers reported in Chittagong (343), Dhaka outside city corporations (320), and Dhaka South City Corporation (210). Other divisions also saw significant numbers of new patients.

The Health Directorate's data, released on Wednesday, September 30, highlights the ongoing public health challenge posed by the mosquito-borne disease. Efforts to control mosquito breeding and prevent further spread are crucial.
